acquisition_method.evidence: The Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) was operated in positive ion mode using data-dependent acquisition with a survey MS scan at a resolution of 70,000 (FWHM at m/z 200), followed by MS/MS scans (resolution 17,500) of the top ten most intense peaks with +2, +3, +4, and +5 charged ions above a threshold ion count of 16,000 using normalized collision energy (NCE) of 25 eV with an isolation window of 2.0 m/z, apex trigger of 5-15s and dynamic exclusion of 30s.
